programme.title: Ghar Mein Ram Gali Mein Shyam
programme.desc: Amar weds a village belle and they move to the city where she meets her neighbours Mr and Mrs Dharamchand. Soon, Amar begins to doubt her fidelity and Dharamchand devises a scheme to separate them.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Aakhri Ghulam
programme.desc: Bheema, his father Dinu and generations of their family have been slaves of the wealthy Thakurs. One day, he challenges their authority and invites trouble for himself in the process.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Fifty Fifty
programme.desc: Abandoned by his parents, Kishan becomes an elusive robber and teams up with Mary. However, when she leaves him to pursue her grand plan, he decides to seek revenge from the man who ruined his life.

programme.title: Maati Maangey Khoon
programme.desc: Hariya is clueless about his parents and discovers that his family was destroyed by Thakur Balram Singh. He vows to take revenge, especially after his friend, who is Balram's nephew, also opposes him.

programme.title: Viduthalai Part 1
programme.desc: A policeman is conflicted between duty and morality when his department begins a brutal campaign to capture a local activist.

programme.title: The Real Hunter
programme.desc: To fuel his political ambitions, Vijay's father fixes his marriage with an affluent girl. However, after Vijay falls for an ordinary villager and plans on marrying her, his father plans to stop him.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Laila
programme.desc: As a young boy, Deshraj was sent away for higher studies in order to protect him from a rival family's wrath. But upon his return, he falls in love with a girl who is the daughter of the same enemy.

programme.title: Kaali Topi Laal Roomaal
programme.desc: Commando Vijay arrests a terrorist, Master DD. However, he realises that Master DD is just a pawn and tries to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Karishma Kudrat Ka
programme.desc: Widower Vijay lives in a village with his family. He unwittingly makes an enemy in Lala and a bandit, Bhagad, who conspire and throw him out of the village. But Vijay soon returns as a changed man.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Yeh Hai Judgementâ€
programme.desc: Ashraf Ansari, a local resident of Mumbai, is taken into custody as a suspect for the bomb blast that shakes the entire city. He battles with the police and the corrupt system to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Chalte Chalte
programme.desc: Geeta is admitted to a mental hospital after her lover passes away tragically. Later, she gains her senses, only to find him alive and in love with another woman.

programme.title: Mr. Natwarlal
programme.desc: When Natwar's elder brother is framed for bribery, he decides to avenge his brother's humiliation and thus poses as a crime lord.

programme.title: Geet
programme.desc: After losing her ability to sing, Neha, a famous star, relocates to a small village. While she attempts to get back her voice, she encounters Rajesh, who decides to help her.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: Juaari
programme.desc: Vijay, a young man, resorts to gambling in order to free his lover, Anita, who is held captive by Sanga. He soon runs out of luck when he gets arrested.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

programme.title: Drishyam
programme.desc: When the disappearance of a policewoman's son threatens to ruin Vijay's family, he leaves no stone unturned in order to shield his family.

programme.title: Pardesi
programme.desc: Myna rescues Ajay, who is bitten by a snake, but he loses his memory. He begins a new life with Myna and her family and the two fall in love, much to her secret lover's outrage.

programme.title: 28 Weeks Later
programme.desc: The US military oversees the repopulation of Britain after a virus that turned those infected into bloodthirsty killers finally dies out. Two children sneak away from a London safe zone and make a discovery that threatens to unleash the virus again. Juan Carlos Fresnadillo's horror sequel to 28 Days Later, with Robert Carlyle, Rose Byrne, Jeremy Renner, Imogen Poots and Idris Elba.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Inspector Gadget
programme.desc: A clumsy security guard is critically injured during a run-in with a thief, so his cybernetics-expert employer transforms him into the ultimate crime-fighting machine - a bionic officer with an array of gadgets and weaponry cunningly concealed inside his body. Comedy adventure based on the 1980s cartoon series, starring Matthew Broderick, Rupert Everett and Joely Fisher.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: The Tigger Movie
programme.desc: Tigger realises being the only one of his kind makes for a lonely life, so he sets off on a bold quest to find more creatures just like him, with the help of his woodland friends. Animated adventure, with the voices of Jim Cummings, Nikita Hopkins, Ken Sansom, John Fiedler, Tom Attenborough and Peter Cullen.

programme.title: A Goofy Movie
programme.desc: The Disney cartoon dog takes his son on an old-fashioned fishing trip in an attempt to bond with the lad. However, young Max has boasted to his pals that he is going to a pop concert in Los Angeles, and has a few ideas on how to trick his dopey dad. Animated comedy, featuring the voices of Bill Farmer, Jason Marsden and Wallace Shawn.

programme.title: Mary Poppins Returns
programme.desc: In 1930s London, Michael Banks lives in his family home with his children, Annabel, John, and Georgie. Still grieving the death of his wife, and behind on loan payments, his house is due to be repossessed unless he comes up with the money soon. Thankfully, help comes in the form of the practically perfect nanny who returns 25 years after her previous visit. Musical fantasy, starring Emily Blunt, Dick Van Dyke and Meryl Streep.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol 2
programme.desc: After saving Xandar from Ronan's wrath, intergalactic outlaws Peter Quill (AKA Star-Lord), Gamora, Drax the Destroyer, Groot and Rocket Raccoon are recognised as heroes. Now, they must fight to stay together as they unravel the mystery surrounding Ego, a man who claims to be Quill's father. Writer/director James Gunn's follow up to his 2014 blockbuster, which reunites Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana, Karen Gillan and Dave Bautista, with support from Kurt Russell, Sylvester Stallone and Pom Klementieff. Bradley Cooper also provides the voice of Rocket and Vin Diesel is Groot.

programme.title: Deadpool & Wolverine
programme.desc: The wise-cracking mercenary teams up with the resurrected X-Men veteran to take on a lethal adversary. Superhero sequel, starring Ryan Reynolds, Hugh Jackman, Emma Corrin and Matthew Macfadyen.

programme.title: A Complete Unknown
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Bob Dylan arrives in wintry 1961 New York to visit his idol, Woody Guthrie, in self-imposed convalescence at Greystone Park Psychiatric Hospital. An impromptu acoustic performance of a song that Bob has written for Woody propels his star into the ascendancy. Oscar-nominated biopic, starring Timothee Chalamet.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: The Good Dinosaur
programme.desc: In a world where the asteroid impact that wiped out the dinosaurs never happened, humans have evolved as a primitive species while the giant lizards remain the dominant life form on Earth. A young apatosaurus becomes separated from his family, but finds a friend in a feral human boy as he makes the dangerous journey home. Pixar animated adventure, with the voices of Raymond Ochoa and Jack Bright.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: Clownfish Nemo becomes separated from his friends on the Great Barrier Reef - but the thrill of being able to swim freely and away from his overprotective father turns to horror when he is netted by a diver. His distraught dad sets out on a mission to find him, while the youngster finds himself in a dentist's tropical tank. Animated adventure, with the voices of Albert Brooks, Ellen DeGeneres, Alexander Gould, Willem Dafoe, Barry Humphries and Geoffrey Rush.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Ryan Potter, Scott Adsit and Daniel Henney.

Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

programme.desc: S3 E21 — RushBeverly smothers Barry when he tells her that she favours Adam. Meanwhile, Murray is not happy about Erica's new boyfriend who is a Rush fanatic.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S3 E22 — Smother's DayWhen Beverly receives last-minute mum coupons for Mother's Day, she feels upset. Elsewhere, Adam wants to go to space camp.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S4 E1 — Breakfast ClubAdam tries to up his coolness level on the first day of high school, Beverly gets her teaching certification but is subsequently demoted to sub-janitor, and the Goldberg kids are sent to Saturday detention.

programme.title: The Goldbergs
programme.desc: S4 E2 — I Heart Video DatingErica and Lainey try to set Lainey's father Bill up with a 'woman of interest' by using new video dating technology. They recruit Adam to make a show reel about Bill, but Beverly insists she will find him someone to date in the old-fashioned way.

programme.title: Hollyoaks: Omnibus
programme.desc: E28Tensions rise when Ste takes part in Leah's podcast, and Jenson protects Gemma. Meanwhile, a lavish dinner party at Leah and Imran's new home leads to an evening of soul-searching as secrets are confessed and lies are spun.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: S3 E1 — Dude RanchWhile holidaying on Lost Creek Ranch, the three families try their hands at a little cattle herding, skeet shooting and horseback riding. There is also a face-off between Jay and a cowboy named Hank.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: S3 E2 — When Good Kids Go BadMitch and Cam decide to adopt another baby. Now they just need to get little Lily on board. Plus, Gloria locks horns with Manny's principal.

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Keating HotelGordon Ramsay visits The Keating, a 'luxury' boutique hotel in San Diego, California. Owner, Eddie Kaen, has blown millions designing the hotel to look like an Italian sports car, but neglected to spend money on things the guests really need.

programme.title: Ramsay's Hotel Hell
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Meson De MesillaMeson de Mesilla is a Tuscan-style hotel in New Mexico. Owner and former child-star Cali Szczawinski bought the hotel so that she could perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience.

programme.desc: S1 E2 — La RiojaJames visits Spain's wine region of La Rioja and a mile-long cellar - he also eats tapas in the region's capital of Logroño, explores a Michelin-starred restaurant in a tiny town and a community garden rich in produce, and cooks quail, tapas, tomatada and leeks.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Sizzling SteakTom Kerridge shows how to use the barbecue to create the finest meals, cooking a Cote de Boeuf cut of beef, and a classic lobster thermidor also gets the barbecue treatment.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Smoking HotTom takes his inspiration from American barbecue culture for his recipes, making sticky baby back ribs, smoked burgers and Caesar salad with a grilled spring cabbage twist.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E3 — The BurgerTom gets experimental, with a recipe for a chorizo pork burger tower and a seared cucumber salad. Plus, he bakes a cake on his barbecue, full of smoke and honey flavours.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Ultimate KebabTom fires up his barbecue for a Middle Eastern feast. On the menu are marinated and spiced chicken kebabs, cumin flame-grilled flatbread, and a creamy aubergine dip.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Show Off SeafoodTom brings on beach holiday vibes with a seafood feast. He cooks up a huge seafood platter with razor clams, spice-buttered oysters and langoustines.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Roast ChickenTom shares his recipe for jerk-spiced chicken that's barbecued on top of a beer can, with whole sweetcorn as a side. He also serves up barbecue chicken wings.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E7 — Stylish DinnerTom demonstrates three recipes for an intimate alfresco dinner for two, with dishes including chicken yakitori skewers with papaya salad, chargrilled sea bass, and barbecued peaches.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E8 — Slow Cooked FeastTom shares his method for slow-cooking joints of meat, including spicy slow-cooked lamb shoulder, sweet and sticky barbecue short ribs, and pulled beef brisket in a bun.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Superior SandwichTom Kerridge demonstrates how to make some delectable barbecue sandwiches, including a classic meatball sub roll and fresh tuna steak tacos with zingy salsas.

programme.title: Tom Kerridge Barbecues
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Spice Things UpTom Kerridge explores some seriously spicy flavours on his barbecue. He makes fragrant lamb koftas, spicy sweet potato burgers and curried BBQ monkfish.

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S1 E1Jamie Oliver presents easy recipes that use just five ingredients to deliver maximum flavour, from a genius way to cook chicken, to pie with the easiest dough ever, and a treat from the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, José Pizarro.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S33 E3 — Full of SurprisesGuy Fieri digs into some surprising ingredients. In Santa Fe, a culinary pub serves lamb neck, and a Kansas City tapas joint dishes out duck tongue tacos. In El Paso, a deli makes pupusas and fries from chickpeas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S33 E4 — Far-Flung FlavorGuy Fieri heads out to grab international flavours. Dishes include shawarma and salmon souvlaki in Santa Fe and Scandinavian specialities in Kansas City, Missouri. Plus, in El Paso, a tortilla factory turning out top-notch tamales and tostadas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E1 — ClassicsGuy Fieri finds a secret burger recipe in Texas, makes an over-easy egg in a Kansas diner and finds a Mediterranean hot spot.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E2 — ItalianGuy finds great Italian food including pasta and meat sauce in Tennessee, sausage and peppers in Texas and stromboli in Las Vegas.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Blue Plate SpecialsGuy tries fried pickles and corn dogs in North Carolina, Italian beef at a Chicago drive-in, and the Governator's special in LA.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E4 — BreakfastGuy focuses on breakfast and digs into the famous garbage plate in Wisconsin and tries killer omelettes in a Nevada diner.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E5 — BBQGuy is on the hunt for some of the best barbecue in America. He tries some world-famous brisket, and journeys to a place where carhops bring pulled pork and fried chicken to the car.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E6 — Local LegendsGuy finds some places that have been drawing the crowds and bringing back the locals for years. He tries gourmet specials in Maine, amazing ribs in Oklahoma and home-made bread in New York.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E2 — Sausage, Shawarma and ScaloppiniA funky Italian joint in Wilmington, Del., serves arancini and veal scaloppini; a Middle Eastern street food spot in San Diego serves shawarma and falafel; a not-your-typical pizza place in Vancouver tops things off with lamb sausage and pig cheeks.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E4 — British, Hawaiian and MexicanGuy grabs grub from all around the globe; in Wilmington, Del., there's a true British pub serving authentic English staples from fish and chips to Yorkshire Pudding; a poke counter is dishing out a Hawaiian classic with an updated twist in Kauai.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E5 — Standout SeafoodA seafood spot in Vancouver combines sustainability with killer cooking, including bouillabaisse and salmon fish and chips. A fresh-catch institution in Kauai puts out prime-time poke. A raw bar in Chico cooks up Asian flavours.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S32 E7 — Crazy Chicken and Twisted BurgersGuy Fieri's digging into crazy twists on chicken and burgers; in Wilmington, Del., there's a bourbon bar that's piling pork onto a patty and doctoring up chicken skins.

programme.sub-title: North East Starter and Fish Courses

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through their heat and will serve up their main courses and desserts. The stakes are high and again they are each serving a unique take on the pop music brief. Mike is confident about his northern dish, `Rack n Roll', which puts both classic Yorkshire hogget and traditional Lancashire hotpot in the spotlight.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining North East chefs must cook their four course menus again for the judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the British pop industry's finest.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Newcomer Kray brings an urban edge to proceedings, with a starter inspired by Grime Music called `Fire in the Booth'. It combines hot sauce, veal sweetbreads and tuna belly. Returner Sabrina is compiling a dish of her favourite ingredients, including pasta and ox cheek, for her Italian inspired starter called `My Mixtape'.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: For his main course, Ryan Simpson-Trotman is confident his dish, `The UK's Number 1', will hit the top spot with his combination of a beef pie and rump cap. Sabrina Gidda is taking inspiration from her grandad's collection of old 45s for her `Sunday Jukebox' main: pork Wellington and Black Country faggots.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Central chefs must cook their four course menus again for judges food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Competing for a place on the banquet menu are two chefs returning to the competition for a second time, plus a supremely talented newcomer. Liam Simpson, who co-owns a high-end gastropub near Henley-on-Thames, is hoping to make it all the way after being knocked out in the heats during the 2018 competition.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs are halfway through the regional heats and, as the lowest scoring chef will be eliminated from the competition at the end of the show, the pressure is on. They start by cooking their all-important main courses, the centrepiece of the banquet menu. Michelin-starred newcomer Hrishikesh Desai is pushing himself to the limit with a complex multi-part venison dish, inspired by the bands which play at the Kendal Calling music festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from the north west cook their dishes head to head for a panel of expert judges, in a bid to secure themselves a place in the national finals. Will they have acted on the advice given by the veteran judge earlier in the week, and learn from their mistakes?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three of Scotland's finest chefs do battle for a chance to cook at the banquet celebrating 50 Years of Popular Music. Gordon Jones, the only newcomer, faces returners Lorna McNee and Ben Reade, who are going head-to-head for the second time.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs cook their mains and desserts, each battling to produce smash hit dishes that wow their veteran. For her main, Lorna is confident her lamb dish `With A Little Help From My Friends', dedicated to supportive friends, is a celebratory dish fit for the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining Scottish chefs must cook their four courses again, but this time they'll need to appeal to four new palates: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton, broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver plus a celebrity guest judge.

programme.title: Great British Menu

Joe Baker is largely self-taught, but at just 28 already running his own restaurant, `No 10', in St Helier. A neighbouring restaurant is Michelin starred `Samphire' where Lee Smith is head chef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Emily's David Bowie inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes and she's using Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Joe has sourced his ingredients locally too, using hay from his family farm and Jersey beef.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Tom `Westy' Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant `The Classroom' in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheriden formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish `The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury festival.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

programme.title: Killer in the House: The Murders of Lesley Howell and Trevor Buchanan
programme.desc: S1 E2This documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. Colin Howell was a married dentist with four children and a pillar of the Baptist community in Coleraine, but was having an affair with married Sunday school teacher Hazel Buchanan. They agreed the only way they could be together was if they murdered their spouses and Howell devised a plot to poison them with carbon monoxide fumes and then stage their deaths as a double suicide.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Christmas Special
programme.desc: S36 E1 — Christmas Special 2025Celebrity Traitors veteran Joe Marler and comedian Katherine Ryan each hope to climb the money ladder and raise funds for their chosen charities. As usual there will be lifelines, including 50:50, Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend, and Ask the Host. With up to £1 million on the table, who will hold their nerve under Jeremy Clarkson's gaze and can anyone beat Stephen Fry's impressive £250,000 win.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E49 — Norway v EnglandNorway v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the third quarter-final, which takes place at Miami Stadium in the USA. This is a step into the unknown for the Norwegians, who have never made it to a World Cup quarter-final, and did so in style, beating Brazil 2-1 in the last round, courtesy of two more goal from Erling Haaland. England overcame several obstacles to win 3-2 against Mexico in the last 16, producing one of their finest performances to hold on and book a quarter-final place, with Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham once again among the goals.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Innovative interview show in which celebrities are quizzed by an audience of inquisitive individuals who are autistic, neurodivergent or learning disabled.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E10Adil Ray hosts as RuPaul's Drag Race UK stars Tia Kofi and Danny Beard take on former England goalkeeper David Seaman and his wife, Dancing on Ice professional Frankie Seaman, in the game of words. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

This is a step into the unknown for the Norwegians, who have never made it to a World Cup quarter-final, and did so in style, beating Brazil 2-1 in the last round, courtesy of two more goal from Erling Haaland. England overcame several obstacles to win 3-2 against Mexico in the last 16, producing one of their finest performances to hold on and book a quarter-final place, with Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham once again among the goals.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Japan v IrelandJapan v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of both teams' second round-robin match, held at McDonald Jones Stadium in Newcastle, Australia. programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.desc: S1 E2This documentary examines the case of one of the UK's most notorious double killings. programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Japan v IrelandJapan v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of both teams' second round-robin match, held at McDonald Jones Stadium in Newcastle, Australia. programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v EnglandFiji v England (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the round-robin match at Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool. While Fiji are the designated hosts, the match is being played here because their main stadium does not meet the competition requirements. England prevailed 38-18 when the teams last met at Allianz Stadium Twickenham last November and will expect another victory this afternoon. With analysis from Danny Care and Maggie Alphonsi, commentary by Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay, and pitchside inserts from Topsy Ojo.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: South Africa v ScotlandSouth Africa v Scotland (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the round-robin match at Loftus Versfeld Stadium in Pretoria. Scotland face a daunting task away to the world champions, who have won the last nine meetings between the sides. With analysis from Grieg Laidlaw, Bryan Habana and John Barclay, and commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E49 — Norway v EnglandNorway v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the third quarter-final, which takes place at Miami Stadium in the USA. This is a step into the unknown for the Norwegians, who have never made it to a World Cup quarter-final, and did so in style, beating Brazil 2-1 in the last round, courtesy of two more goal from Erling Haaland. England overcame several obstacles to win 3-2 against Mexico in the last 16, producing one of their finest performances to hold on and book a quarter-final place, with Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham once again among the goals.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Argentina v Switzerland (Kick-off 2.00am). Coverage of the fourth quarter-final, which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Current World Cup holders Argentina survived an almighty scare in the last round as they came from 2-0 down to win 3-2 against Egypt. The African side had gone two goals ahead with 23 minutes remaining but three goals inside 13 minutes from Cristian Romero, Lionel Messi and Enzo Fernandez saw Argentina progress to their second successive quarter-final in this competition. Switzerland reached their first quarter-final since 1954 after they beat Colombia 4-3 on penalties after the game finished 0-0 in Vancouver. Before Tuesday's victory the European side had reached the round-of-16 at the last three World Cups, but heroics from goalkeeper Gregor Kobel ended that run and helped them reach this stage for the first time in 72 years

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: New Zealand v ItalyNew Zealand v Italy (Kick-off 6.10am). Coverage of both teams' second round-robin match in the rugby union competition, held at Hnry Stadium in Wellington. With commentary by Nick Heath and Nolli Waterman.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Australia v FranceAustralia v France (Kick-off 8.40am). Ugo Monye presents all the action from the round-robin match at Suncorp Stadium in Brisbane. With analysis from Benjamin Kayser and George Gregan, and commentary by Claire Thomas and Tom Shanklin.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Japan v IrelandJapan v Ireland (Kick-off 11.10am). Ugo Monye presents coverage of both teams' second round-robin match, held at McDonald Jones Stadium in Newcastle, Australia. Japan coach Eddie Jones returns to the dugout after serving a four-match suspension, but his team will have to be at their best to defeat Ireland, who won 41-10 when the teams met in Dublin last November. With analysis from Rory Best and Stuart Lancaster, and commentary by Martin Gillingham and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Fiji v EnglandFiji v England (Kick-off 2.10pm). Jill Douglas presents all the action from the round-robin match at Hill Dickinson Stadium in Liverpool. England prevailed 38-18 when the teams last met at Allianz Stadium Twickenham last November and will expect another victory this afternoon. With analysis from Danny Care and Maggie Alphonsi, commentary by Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay, and pitchside inserts from Topsy Ojo.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: South Africa v ScotlandSouth Africa v Scotland (Kick-off 4.40pm). Lauren Salter presents coverage of the round-robin match at Loftus Versfeld Stadium in Pretoria. Scotland face a daunting task away to the world champions, who have won the last nine meetings between the sides. The most recent of those contests was a 32-15 victory for the Springboks in a 2024 autumn international at Murrayfield. With analysis from Grieg Laidlaw, Bryan Habana and John Barclay, and commentary by Miles Harrison and Johnnie Beattie.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: S11 E52 — 11/07/2026Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: It'll Be Alright on the Night
programme.desc: S37 E1Comedian Tom Allen celebrates the chaos that occurs when making TV shows with unseen outtakes from dramas, comedies and entertainment shows. This episode features an accidental innuendo with Idris Elba that leaves Lorraine in tears of laughter, Love Island filming that is interrupted by angry animals, and an interview with Hollywood star Paul Rudd that ends in disaster.

programme.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? Christmas Special
programme.desc: S36 E1 — Christmas Special 2025Celebrity Traitors veteran Joe Marler and comedian Katherine Ryan each hope to climb the money ladder and raise funds for their chosen charities. As usual there will be lifelines, including 50:50, Ask the Audience, Phone a Friend, and Ask the Host. With up to £1 million on the table, who will hold their nerve under Jeremy Clarkson's gaze and can anyone beat Stephen Fry's impressive £250,000 win.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E49 — Norway v EnglandNorway v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the third quarter-final, which takes place at Miami Stadium in the USA. This is a step into the unknown for the Norwegians, who have never made it to a World Cup quarter-final, and did so in style, beating Brazil 2-1 in the last round, courtesy of two more goal from Erling Haaland. England overcame several obstacles to win 3-2 against Mexico in the last 16, producing one of their finest performances to hold on and book a quarter-final place, with Harry Kane and Jude Bellingham once again among the goals.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: Innovative interview show in which celebrities are quizzed by an audience of inquisitive individuals who are autistic, neurodivergent or learning disabled.

programme.title: Goals of the 1990s
programme.desc: S1 E1A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by David Platt, Diego Maradona and Michael Owen, and Euros classics from Paul Gascoigne, Davor Suker and Karel Poborsky.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: S5 E50 — Fourth Quarter-FinalCoverage of the fourth quarter-final (Kick-off 2.00am), which takes place at Kansas City Stadium in the USA. Familiar foes England and France faced each other for the 32nd time in the corresponding match in Qatar, and it was France who came out on top in a see-saw encounter. Aurélien Tchouaméni was first on the scoresheet for France in the 17th minute, and it took until the 54th minute for England to draw level through a Harry Kane penalty, as he scored a record-equalling 53rd goal for his country. Olivier Giroud, who entered the contest as the top scorer for his own country, put Les Bleus back in the driving seat as he somewhat remarkably also netted a 53rd international goal. The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: Celebrity Lingo
programme.desc: S2 E10Adil Ray hosts as RuPaul's Drag Race UK stars Tia Kofi and Danny Beard take on former England goalkeeper David Seaman and his wife, Dancing on Ice professional Frankie Seaman, in the game of words. They must try to use their powers of deduction to fill in the blanks and find the missing words in the Lingo grids and Puzzlewords.

The Three Lions had the opportunity to level the score once again when they were awarded a VAR penalty four minutes from full time, but this time Kane saw his effort blaze over the bar and England were eliminated in the quarter-finals for a record seventh time, while Didier Deschamps' men became the first reigning champions to reach the last four since Brazil in 1998.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E6New weapons with devastating force shape the wars of the 20th century. International experts test the catastrophic effects of the three most destructive weapons of our time: the machine gun, hand grenade and tank.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E7A look at key maritime weapons such as the secret super-weapon that kept Constantinople safe for centuries, the thunderous force of a ship's cannon, and the deadly torpedo.

programme.title: History Of Weapons
programme.desc: E8Examining how the techniques of ambush, along with weapons that remained undetected until the very moment they were used, would revolutionise warfare.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E4Destroyers and Cruisers showcases ships that with their speed and firepower became the backbones of 20th century navies. We tell the incredible story of USS Laffey, the WW2 destroyer that would come to be known as ‘the ship that would not die’.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2Unusually, we look at the later, clipped wing version flown by Czech refugee pilots in the UK during WW2. We get close-up with a beautifully restored example, fly her and unearth long unseen test and operational footage.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E3Icons of the Royal Navy in different eras, the Belfast and the Harrier have earned their place in history for different reasons.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4Two of the most produced combat machines in World War II managed to stay relevant until the end of the war through constant modernization and new variants.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The definitive combat helicopter saw first blood in South East Asia and has been transport, gunship, smoke ship, command centre, MediVac and dozens of other roles. We hear and see it's hair raising missions and watch it earn its fame.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The aircraft capable of delivering the payload of a B17, in a single post war air frame. The many variants of this single piston engined fighter bomber helped dominate the air to ground attack role in Vietnam, earning quite a reputation.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War
programme.desc: E3Bruno Tonioli joins Al to look at key battle tactics during the Roman Invasion back in AD 43.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War
programme.desc: E4Al faces up to the richest nation on Earth to discover how the former British colony of America somehow slipped through its fingers.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E2December 7th, 1942. Off the coast of France, ten British commandos board five canoes in the middle of the ocean. Their objective: to paddle to the Gironde estuary, then up the river to Bordeaux to sabotage German ships.

programme.title: Commando Missions
programme.desc: E1In the north of Crete, six commandos land in a cove. On this island that has been occupied for two years, they have been given a high-risk mission—to infiltrate the Heraklion airfield to destroy the Luftwaffe bombers and fighter planes.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The definitive, if not the best, Axis fighter of World War two: we delve into the story of legendary ace Adolf Galland and examine in detail and example of the type in his colours. We also look at the technical heritage the 109 designers left.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The story of the prolonged development and the initially troubled operational history of the Boeing B-29 Superfortress. Forever known as the airframe that dropped the first atomic weapons on Japan, the B-29 lived on well beyond its war years.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5This episode tells stories about the secret world of naval deception and cloak and dagger missions. 1914, the yacht Asgard, manned by Erskine Childers, smuggled rifles into a fishing village to arm an Irish militia in their struggle for Home Rule.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6The 16th century witnessed a revolution in combat ship design and saw the birth of two legendary sea captains; Sir John Hawkins and Sir Francis Drake – both superb seamen and adventurers who would have a lasting impact on naval history.

programme.title: Al Murray: Why Do The Brits Win Every War

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury

programme.title: WWII Air Crash Detectives
programme.desc: E5A C-47 transport plane, with a crew of four, is ferrying 24 trainee P-47 fighter pilots from the Bruning Army Air Field in Nebraska to the South Dakotan Pierre Army Air Field for advanced training.
